gloss: penetration rate; adoption rate; rate of spread

definitions.gloss: penetration rate; adoption rate; rate of spread
definitions.explanation: The percentage or proportion showing how widely something has spread or been adopted in a population.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{普及率|ふきゅうりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The smartphone adoption rate is high.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{普及率|ふきゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}している→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
examples.english: The internet penetration rate is rising year after year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{普及率|ふきゅうりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Japan's air conditioner adoption rate is very high even by global standards.

notes:
Combines ⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧ (spread/dissemination) and ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate/ratio). Used in statistics, reports, and news to express how widely a product, technology, or practice has been adopted. The ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ suffix is productive and attaches to many nouns to form rate/ratio compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普及率|ふきゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high adoption rate
- {普及率|ふきゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low adoption rate
- {普及率|ふきゅうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: the adoption rate rises
- {普及率|ふきゅうりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to research the adoption rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧: spread/dissemination — the base noun without the rate component
- {浸透率|しんとうりつ}: penetration rate — more technical, used in marketing
- {利用率|りようりつ}: usage rate — focuses on actual use rather than ownership
